ov: A dabbling duck that breeds across the Americas, Eurasia and North Africa and has been introduced to Australia, New Zealand, South America and South Africa. Males have green heads; females are mainly brown. Mallards live in wetlands in groups.

why.et: An important game bird, and the ancestor of most domestic ducks raised for meat.

rg: Native to the Americas, Eurasia and North Africa; introduced to Australia, New Zealand, South America and South Africa.
fx: Mallards average three years of life but can live to twenty.
Ducks were first domesticated in Southeast Asia at least 4,000 years ago.
